svg.title: Illustration of the GEMA Factory maintenance app in flow order: a dashboard with work orders and pending issues, scanning a machine QR code, the machine's details and work order history, and a role-based profile, next to a QR tag on a machine. Demo data.
svg.text: Scan a machine, report the issue, follow the work order to completion

g.text: Scan the QR code to open the machine
Keep the QR in the centre

Clean dust and residue from the unit
